description: This file contains internal tests for distributed RPC optimizers in PyTorch, including classes for modules and optimizers, and test methods for exception handling and optimizer behavior in distributed settings.

classes.name: MyModule
classes.description: A simple neural network module with a weight matrix, supporting forward pass and weight retrieval.

classes.name: FailingOptimizer
classes.description: An optimizer that raises an error during step execution.

classes.name: OptimizerFailingOnConstructor
classes.description: An optimizer that raises an error during initialization.

classes.name: DistOptimizerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for distributed optimizer tests, inheriting from RpcAgentTestFixture.

methods.name: _call_method
methods.description: Calls a method on a remote reference with provided arguments.

methods.name: remote_method
methods.description: Calls rpc.remote on a method in a remote object, returning an RRef to the result.

methods.name: rpc_async_method
methods.description: Calls rpc.rpc_async on a method in a remote object, returning a Future.

methods.name: test_dist_optim_exception
methods.description: Tests that an exception is raised during optimizer step in distributed setting.

methods.name: test_dist_optim_exception_on_constructor
methods.description: Tests that an exception is raised during optimizer creation in distributed setting.

methods.name: _test_dist_optim_base
methods.description: Helper method to test optimizer behavior in distributed setting, comparing local and remote weights.

methods.name: test_dist_optim
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests for different optimizer types in distributed setting.

methods.name: _test_dist_optim_none_grads
methods.description: Tests optimizer behavior with some parameters having no gradients in distributed setting.

methods.name: test_dist_optim_none_grads
methods.description: Runs optimizer tests with parameters that do not require gradients.
